quests.title: The Scout in the Cells
quests.description:
Flamewarden Teodor Novak keeps a room over the inn in Brill and a window that looks east, toward the Scarlet Monastery. He's with the Order of the Pale Flame, the ones who walked out of the Crusade, and he's lost a scout. Her name's Agata, and the Crusade took her on the road a week ago.

He says they'll have taken her down into the Graveyard, to the Chamber of Atonement, where Interrogator Maelis does his work. Agata won't have talked. He wants Maelis dead before she has to.
quests.accept_text: The Monastery's at the top of the road east out of Brill. Go in through the gate, and the Graveyard's down through the crypt chapel on the west side of the close. Maelis keeps to the torture room at the bottom of the halls. If Agata's alive, tell her Teo sent you, and she'll know you're one of ours.
quests.turn_in_text:
She was alive, then, and she's on her way here. Thank you.

I was a firefighter in Brno before all this. You learn to count who comes out. I'm still counting.

quests.title: A Book of Names
quests.description:
Agata heard things in the cells. The Crusade has an archivist in the Library, a woman they call Archivist Dana Mercer, and she writes everything down: every camp the Crusade has burned, every name, every date. She was a records clerk back home, Agata says, and she's very good at it.

Novak wants that ledger. There are families from home looking for people who were in those camps, and the Order owes them an answer, even a bad one.
quests.accept_text: Mercer keeps to the Closed Stacks, off the long hall that turns north in the Library. She'll shut your casters down if she can, so bring someone who hits things. The ledger doesn't leave her desk.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's her hand. I knew a few of these camps.

I'll copy it out for the Flamekeeper, and then I'll start writing letters. Some of these people have been waiting three years.

quests.title: Cold Steel
quests.description:
The ledger says where the Crusade sends its armour, and it's all made in one place: the forge off the Crusader's Armory in the Monastery, where Smithmaster Corra Bellweather works day and night.

Novak wants her notebook. If the Order knows what the Crusade wears, the Order knows where it's thin.
quests.accept_text: The Monastery's east of here, up the road, and the Armory's the middle door under its front. Go through the Training Grounds and the two armouries, and the forge is up the short passage off the Crusader's Armory. She tempers her plate while you hit her, so don't let it pile up.
quests.turn_in_text:
Every buckle and rivet. She was thorough.

The Flamekeeper's going to like this. He was an ironworker in Boston, and he'll read it the way other men read letters from home.

quests.title: The Captain of the Doors
quests.description:
Novak has never told anyone in Brill why the Order left the Crusade, and he tells you now. The night Rory Callahan walked out, the Crusade burned a camp of transplants on the Darrowmere road for consorting with the dead. The man who gave the order was Captain Elric Stane, and he captains the Chapel Guard at the Cathedral's doors today.

Novak doesn't want an apology. He wants Stane's signet, so the Flamekeeper knows it's done.
quests.accept_text: The Monastery's east of here, up the road, and the Cathedral's its right-hand door. Cross the Chapel Gardens and go up the steps, and Stane stands at the top. He'll call his centurions to him, so deal with them first or they'll bury you.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's the ring. I've seen it on his hand in a doorway with the fire behind him.

Take it to Rory yourself. He should hear it from the one who did it.

quests.title: The Flamekeeper's Due
quests.description:
Novak wants Stane's signet put into Flamekeeper Rory Callahan's hand at the Bulwark, the Forsaken's wall at the end of Tirisfal's east road, where the Order keeps its quarter.

The road there runs past the Bulwark and into country that kills people who aren't ready for it. Novak says to wait until you are, and then to go.

objectives.label: Bring Stane's signet to Flamekeeper Rory Callahan at the Bulwark

quests.accept_text: Take the east road out of Tirisfal to the Bulwark. The Order's banners are on the south side of the street, and Rory stands at the keep's door. Don't go before you're ready. I mean that.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's Elric Stane's ring.

I stood next to him for a year, God help me, and I never once stopped him. Sit yourself down, because there's a lot of work out here, and the Order could use someone who finishes things.

on_accept.name: Stane's Signet
on_accept.description: Captain Elric Stane's signet ring, wrapped in a scrap of Novak's shirt.

quests.title: The Monastery's Dead
quests.description:
Gravedigger Hollis has buried half of Brill, some of them twice. The burial ground at the Scarlet Monastery was Lordaeron's before it was the Crusade's, and the people in it were somebody's family.

They don't rest any more. The Anguished Dead claw their way up out of the graves in the Forlorn Cloister, and the Haunting Phantasms drift among the stones. Hollis wants them laid down, gently if you can manage it and any way you can if you can't.
quests.accept_text: The Monastery's east of here, up the road. Go into its Graveyard, through the crypt chapel. Past the halls there's an open burial ground with a mausoleum in the middle. That's where they walk.
quests.turn_in_text:
Thank you. I'll say a word for them, whatever they were.

The Crusade calls us abominations, and then lets its own dead crawl out of the ground. I don't understand them, and I've stopped trying.

quests.title: The Crusade's Zeal
quests.description:
Apothecary Marwen wants to know what the Crusade puts in its faithful. The Scarlet Torturers and the Scarlet Scryers in the Monastery's Graveyard carry little vials of anointing oil, and Marwen thinks there's more in it than oil.

Bring her the vials, and she'll find out what makes a man burn his neighbours and sing while he does it.
quests.accept_text: The Monastery's north of here, in Tirisfal. The Torturers and the Scryers both keep to the halls and the Chamber of Atonement in the Graveyard. Most of them carry a vial. Don't drink any of it.
quests.turn_in_text:
Incense, oil, and something bitter under both.

It's a calming draught, and a strong one. They keep them calm while they do it. That's worse, somehow.

quests.title: The Bloodmage's Stone
quests.description:
Master Apothecary Lorrane Sable has heard that the Crusade keeps a blood mage in the Graveyard's tomb, Bloodmage Thalnos, and that he's kept himself alive a long time on other people.

She wants the stone he does it with. The Society has its own uses for something that keeps a heart beating.
quests.accept_text: The Monastery's north of here, in Tirisfal. Thalnos holds Honor's Tomb, at the far end of the Graveyard past the open burial ground. His ward drinks spells, so hit him with steel. The stone will be on him.
quests.turn_in_text:
It's still warm, and it's still beating.

The Dark Lady will want to know about this. Leave it with me, and don't mention it in the tavern.

quests.title: Doan's Codex
quests.description:
Loremaster Sennarath collects what the living throw away. Arcanist Doan of the Scarlet Crusade has spent years in the Athenaeum at the top of the Monastery's Library, writing a codex of everything he's learned about the dead, and how to end them.

Sennarath would like to read it before Doan uses it on anyone else.
quests.accept_text: The Athenaeum's the great hall of shelves at the north end of the Library, past the Gallery of Treasures. When Doan's close to dying, he'll try to take the room with him. Get away from him.
quests.turn_in_text:
A great deal of this is wrong, and some of it's very, very right.

I'll keep it somewhere safe, which in this city means somewhere I don't tell anyone about.

quests.title: The Champion of the Hall
quests.description:
Deathstalker Rhyne keeps a list of the Crusade's people who matter, and Herod is near the top. He's the Crusade's champion, he holds the Hall of Champions at the back of the Armory, and he's been sending his trainees down the road to Brill to practise.

Rhyne wants that to stop. He doesn't much care how.
quests.accept_text: The Hall of Champions is the last room of the Armory. Herod spins when he's angry, and he gets angry fast, so keep moving. When he falls, his trainees will come running. Don't stand in the doorway.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's good news, and the road to Brill will be quieter for it.

The Crusade has more champions than it has sense. Come back to me, because I've one more name.

quests.title: In the Name of the Light
quests.description:
The last names on Rhyne's list are the Crusade's in the Monastery: High Inquisitor Whitemane and Scarlet Commander Mograine, who keep court together in the Cathedral's chancel.

Rhyne tells you plainly that the Dark Lady knows more about the Crusade's newest recruits than the Crusade does, and that she wants the people giving them orders gone. He won't say more than that.
quests.accept_text: Cross the Chapel Gardens, go up the steps, and walk the length of the Crusader's Chapel. They're at the altar. Mograine gets back up once, and Whitemane will try to put you to sleep. Kill them together.
quests.turn_in_text:
Then it's done, and the Crusade will have a long, loud argument about who leads it next.

The Dark Lady thanks you. I'm told to say that, and this once I mean it.

quests.title: Hounds of the Library
quests.description:
Scout Mirren Vask lost two scouts on the Hillsbrad road last month, run down by Scarlet hounds. She tracked the hounds back to the kennels in the Monastery's Library, and to the man who breeds them, Houndmaster Loksey.

She wants Loksey dead, and his Scarlet Tracking Hounds with him.
quests.accept_text: The kennels are in Huntsman's Cloister, the square of grass at the top of the Library's long halls. Kill the hounds before you go for Loksey, because they'll lick his wounds closed if you don't.
quests.turn_in_text:
Then it's done. I'll tell their families it was dogs, and that the dogs are gone.

It's not much. It's what I've got.

quests.title: Drilled to Die
quests.description:
Commander Vellis Thorne has been finding Scarlet Soldiers dead in the hills, boys from Southshore barely old enough to lift a sword. The Crusade drills them in the Training Grounds of the Monastery's Armory, and the man doing the drilling is one of the newcomers, a Sergeant Major Cole Brennan.

Thorne says Brennan's very good at it. He wants Brennan dead and the yard emptied of Scarlet Soldiers.
quests.accept_text: The Armory's the middle door under the Monastery's front, and the Training Grounds are the open yard just inside. Brennan calls his recruits in waves. Don't let them surround your healer.
quests.turn_in_text:
The newcomers brought a lot of things with them. Some of them brought this, apparently.

I'd rather fight soldiers than children. Thank you for making that likelier.

quests.title: The Preacher in the Nave
quests.description:
Chaplain Ewen Blackwood keeps the Forsaken chapel in Tarren Mill, and he still prays, which makes him strange even here. He's heard about a preacher in the Scarlet Cathedral, Brother Corwin Ashe, one of the newcomers, who fills the nave every night and sends the faithful out to burn.

Blackwood says faith is the one thing he was allowed to keep. He doesn't want to watch it used like that.
quests.accept_text: The Cathedral's the right-hand door. Go up past the gardens and into the Crusader's Chapel. Ashe preaches in the middle of the nave. His sermon shields him, so keep at him.
quests.turn_in_text:
I won't ask how he died. I'll only ask whether he was afraid.

No, don't tell me. I'll pray for him either way, because somebody should.

quests.title: A Letter for Brill
quests.description:
Apothecary Merrow Vane has a friend in Brill who isn't Forsaken and isn't Horde, and who's never once asked Merrow what he is. Flamewarden Teodor Novak watches the Scarlet Monastery for an order called the Pale Flame, and he needs people who can fight.

Merrow has written to him about you. He'd like you to carry the letter yourself.

objectives.label: Bring Merrow's letter to Flamewarden Novak in Brill

quests.accept_text: Take the zeppelin from Orgrimmar to Tirisfal and walk down into Brill. Novak keeps a room over the inn. He's a big man with burn scars on his hands, and he doesn't bite.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's Merrow's handwriting. He always writes like he's apologising.

He says you're good. Sit down, and I'll tell you about the Monastery.

on_accept.name: Merrow's Letter
on_accept.description: A letter sealed with green wax that smells faintly of something medicinal.

quests.title: The Sleepless
quests.description:
Spirit-Walker Enu has looked for Thunder Bluff's dead and found them quiet. A Forsaken traveller who came up the ramp told him about a place where the dead are anything but quiet: the burial ground of the Scarlet Monastery, across the sea in Tirisfal, where a wraith called Azshir the Sleepless feeds on the spirits of the buried.

Enu says a spirit that's eaten never gets to rest at all. He'd like Azshir ended, even so far from home.
quests.accept_text: The zeppelins from Orgrimmar go to Tirisfal. From there it's the road east to the Monastery, and down through the crypt chapel into the Graveyard. Azshir walks the burial ground. Spread out when it wails, and cleanse the curse it lays on you.
quests.turn_in_text:
I felt something loosen, I think, a long way off.

Thank you. The dead there aren't ours, but the dead are the dead.

quests.title: The Master-at-Arms
quests.description:
The warrior trainer in Orgrimmar has heard of a man in the Scarlet Monastery's Armory who has never lost a duel. They call him Master-at-Arms Dorran Pike, and they say he parries a blade and sends it back into the one who swung it.

The trainer would like to know if it's true, and the only way to know is to go and find out.
quests.accept_text: Take the zeppelin to Tirisfal and the road east to the Monastery. The Armory's the middle door. Pike holds the Crusader's Armory. Bring casters, because steel goes back the way it came.
quests.turn_in_text:
So it's true, and he's dead. Both are worth knowing.

I'll teach the young ones what you've told me. Some of them might even listen.

quests.title: The Hale Locket
quests.description:
Corwin Hale left Stormwind for reasons he doesn't talk about, and he took the coast road north to Lordaeron before he came south to the Barrens. The Crusade stopped him on that road and took everything he had, including his daughter's locket.

He's heard it's in a glass case in the Scarlet Monastery's Gallery of Treasures, which is kept by a Curator Halbrecht. He'd like it back.
quests.accept_text: Ride the zeppelin to Tirisfal and take the road east to the Monastery. The Library's the left-hand door. Halbrecht keeps the Gallery of Treasures past the kennels. He'll call his monks when you start, so kill them before you kill him.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's it, and that's her hair, still in it.

She was six when I left. I don't know where she is now. I keep thinking that if I've got this, I'll know her when I find her.

quests.title: Pages for Sun Rock
quests.description:
Loremaster Sennarath has read Doan's codex through, and one chapter has troubled him: Doan studied the dead that rise far from the Scourge, with no necromancer behind them, and he wrote down how it starts. Sennarath has heard that the dead are rising like that in Mulgore.

He's copied the chapter for Spiritwalker Tohana at Sun Rock Retreat, in Stonetalon, who watches that border, and he'd like it carried.

objectives.label: Bring the copied chapter to Spiritwalker Tohana at Sun Rock Retreat

quests.accept_text: Take the zeppelin to Orgrimmar and a wind rider to Sun Rock. Tohana's the one who talks to spirits. Tell him the Crusade's arcanist was wrong about a lot of things, but not, I think, about this.
quests.turn_in_text:
The dead getting up with nobody calling them.

I've watched it happen on the Rim and not known what I was seeing. Now I've got a name for it, and I wish I didn't.

on_accept.name: Copied Chapter
on_accept.description: A sheaf of pages in Sennarath's neat hand, tied with string, titled in Doan's words.
